checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries one family.
timestampBasis: The checkpoint time is the modification time of the family's build-status.json on the build host, which is when the build that produced it finished.

checkpoints.note: JDF 680 and JDF 681 built together. JDF 680 has no AcroForm field at all, so it is built as a measured overlay onto the rules the form prints — 35 blanks, every write box read out of the page's own content stream and re-measured on each build. PF15 returns one row for one assigned family, COMPLETED, not self-verified.
